coded_answer.p:
We have been talking for hours in our class about
the treatment of the media regarding famous people
.

Of course I must agree with the opinion of my
class - mates
: famous people, such as actors, singers or politicians, deserve to have a private life, but of course it is not always
like this
!

Almost
the time they have journalists following them everywhere
and all the time
, looking for
great
news
or interesting pictures to put on the
first
page of the newspaper, and I don't think this is very nice, but
is the price that famous people have to pay, just
becouse
they are popular.

Anyway, this is not always
necessary
a problem, but it can be a big thing for the famous person,
becouse
let
people talking about him and
increase
his popularity.

In conclusion, I can say that this is not the
bigger
problem that the world has and -- it is not my problem
becouse
I am not famous!

p.s: We have been talking for hours in our class about the treatment of the media regarding famous people.
Of course I must agree with the opinion of my class - mates: famous people, such as actors, singers or politicians, deserve to have a private life, but of course it is not always like this!

Almost the time they have journalists following them everywhere and all the time, looking for great news or interesting pictures to put on the first page of the newspaper, and I don't think this is very nice, but is the price that famous people have to pay, just becouse they are popular.
Anyway, this is not always necessary a problem, but it can be a big thing for the famous person, becouse let people talking about him and increase his popularity.
In conclusion, I can say that this is not the bigger problem that the world has and -- it is not my problem becouse I am not famous!
